data.one_liner: A material design slider and range slider for Flutter supporting horizontal and vertical axes and RTL.
data.what_it_does: Provides single and range sliders with extensive options including custom trackbars, tooltips, handlers, fixed values, step ranges, and hatch marks. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations as well as RTL layouts.
use_when: You need a highly customizable single or range slider in Flutter
You need vertical sliders or right-to-left (RTL) slider support
You require custom handlers, tooltips, hatch marks, or non-linear step ranges
avoid_when: Standard Material Slider and RangeSlider widgets completely meet your design requirements
strengths: Highly customizable handlers, trackbars, and tooltips
Supports both horizontal and vertical axes, plus RTL
Advanced features like fixed values, ignore steps, and range steps
weaknesses: Older package version; many configuration properties may require careful reading of documentation
